name: com.hairlosscompare/hair-loss-prices
title: HairLossCompare: US hair loss treatment prices
description: US hair loss treatment prices at Hims, Keeps, Ro and other clinics, dated, with source pages.

tools.name: find_hair_loss_prices
tools.description: Lowest current US self-pay prices of a hair-loss medicine at online clinics. Accepts a medicine (finasteride, minoxidil, dutasteride, spironolactone, finasteride and minoxidil), a form (oral minoxidil, topical finasteride) or a brand (Propecia, Rogaine). Returns the prices ranked per 30 days where the provider states the supply, the lowest plan you can cancel any month at each provider, and the other current prices, each with the provider's own price wording, the check date, the provider's source page, whether HairLossCompare may earn a referral commission, and the HairLossCompare page with every price and its terms.

medication.description: A medicine, form or brand, e.g. "finasteride", "oral minoxidil", "topical finasteride", "dutasteride".

limit.description: How many prices to return per list. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: find_provider_hair_loss_prices
tools.description: Current US self-pay hair-loss prices of one online clinic, such as Hims, Keeps, Ro, Hers, Happy Head, Strut Health or Maximus, ranked per 30 days where the provider states the supply; its other current prices follow in other_prices, each with why it is not ranked. Returns each product, cost per 30 days, the provider's own price wording, the check date, the source page and the provider's page on HairLossCompare (with its alternatives, how to cancel and whether it is legit).

tools.name: list_hair_loss_medications
tools.description: Every hair-loss medicine HairLossCompare keeps a price list for, with how many current prices each has and its page.

tools.name: compare_hair_loss_providers
tools.description: Two US online hair-loss clinics side by side, such as Hims vs Keeps or Hims vs Ro: which is cheaper for each medicine both sell (by the month, with the plan length and the year it adds up to), what only one sells, whether they sell generic or compounded treatments, their public records (Trustpilot, BBB, FDA warning letters) and when each price was read, as HairLossCompare's comparison page answers it, with that page.

tools.name: find_hair_transplant_prices
tools.description: Hair transplant prices US, UK and Turkey clinics publish on their own pages (FUE, FUT and DHI, per graft or per package), each in the clinic's own words with what the price includes, the day it was read, its dollar value at the European Central Bank's rates, and what a session of 2,347 grafts (ISHRS members' average first session) costs where the clinic's own prices say so. Filter by country (us, uk, turkey) or clinic name, e.g. "Smile Hair Clinic", "Bosley".

country.description: "us", "uk" or "turkey"; leave out for every clinic.

clinic.description: A clinic's name, e.g. "Vera Clinic" or "HairClub".
